findings.desc: Pipeline sequences reviewer lanes before verification evidence generation/refresh while assigning coverage verification to validate and the coverage reviewer. Evidence: plan lines around Step Contract Matrix rows for reviewer/evidence and End-To-End Flow show reviewer batch before evidence generation. This can let test-coverage review pass before final material-bound evidence exists, or require an unstated second review loop. Fix by moving evidence generation/refresh before reviewer batch, or explicitly split lanes so coverage/delivery review runs only after final evidence is material-bound.
findings.resolvedReason: Moved verification evidence generation/refresh before final reviewer lane orchestration in the Step Contract Matrix, Pipeline Stages, End-To-End Flow, text flowchart, Mermaid source, and SVG. Added evidence snapshot/stale-pass rules so coverage reviewers cannot pass before material-bound evidence exists. Verified with rg for evidence-before-review and coverage reviewer language.

findings.desc: SVG compresses smoke/transcript/delivery context and jumps toward done_prepare PASS without an explicit delivery-review or delivery-check decision. Markdown preserves the gate, so this is advisory, but the image should show delivery reviewer pass/fail to avoid implying a weaker DONE path.
findings.resolvedReason: Updated SVG flowchart to explicitly state Delivery check fail stops and After delivery PASS delegate readiness to lattice done_prepare; this makes the visual path preserve delivery review before done_prepare.

findings.desc: Metadata-only waiver policy is left open. The plan says transcript/user-value proof may be waived for explicit metadata-only stories, but Track E/F implementers still need a concrete command, schema, and owner before implementing fail-closed behavior. Advisory for current execution-plan doc.
findings.resolvedReason: Added Metadata-Only Waiver Policy with required waiver shape, eligible story types, delivery reviewer acceptance rule, and Authority/local claim boundary. Removed the corresponding open question.

findings.desc: Rendered SVG has visual ambiguity/overlap around PLAN skeleton and DEV implementation boxes. Markdown text flow and Mermaid source remain readable, so this does not block implementation, but the image should be cleaned up for a strict execution-plan artifact.
findings.resolvedReason: Adjusted SVG DEV implementation box x/width to remove overlap with PLAN skeleton box and updated SVG labels to improve readability. XML validation passes with xmllint.

findings.desc: CHK-002 edge evidence only runs xmllint --noout for the SVG. That proves XML validity but not the intent that the SVG visually distinguishes ordinary preflight from TEST-to-DONE done_prepare delegation. The SVG contains relevant nodes, but the recorded evidence command does not assert them, so semantic coverage for CHK-002 edge is missing.
findings.resolvedReason: Replaced CHK-002 edge evidence with semantic SVG grep plus xmllint: it now asserts evidence-before-review, delivery check fail stop, delivery PASS before done_prepare, and done_prepare PASS labels.

findings.desc: Several recorded rg evidence commands are not cleanly replayable because Markdown backticks inside double-quoted shell patterns can trigger command substitution in zsh, producing command-not-found stderr while rg still exits 0. Gate evidence should be deterministic and stderr-clean; replace affected evidence commands with single-quoted patterns or split rg checks that avoid backtick substitution.
findings.resolvedReason: Replaced all affected recorded rg evidence commands with single-quoted patterns or patterns that avoid Markdown backtick command substitution. Replayed the commands cleanly before recording the evidence batch.
